observations.body: Cephas eats with Gentiles before certain people arrive, then withdraws and separates himself.
observations.label: Before and after

observations.body: Other Jews join the action, and Barnabas is also carried along.
observations.label: Spread

observations.body: Paul describes his judgment of the conduct and records the opening of his public address to Cephas.
observations.label: Reported confrontation

payload.posture: Attribute the whole account to Paul’s narrated perspective and keep action, stated fear, effect, judgment, and address distinct.
payload.tension: The same Cephas earlier recognized a mission to the uncircumcised and later withdraws from table fellowship under pressure.
payload.title: Cephas opposed at Antioch
